title: Freetown learning from Miyako: leaving a hazard's reach in time
about: An example of an engagement, every declaration in it an assumption said to be. The client city is Freetown, with its floods; the practice is Japan's preparation for tsunamis as Miyako lives it (hazard maps, designated sites, warnings, drills, leaving at once). The evidence is what the lifelines and evacuation plug-in computes for both places from public data. The standard, the probabilities of the laws and the readings are declared for the example: no plan of Freetown or of Miyako states them, and nothing here is an official plan of either city.
